parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the customer gateway. 

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
用户网关所属的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the customer gateway. 

If you do not specify the instance ID of the customer gateway, the system queries information about all customer gateways in the current region by default
parameters.help_zh:
用户网关的实例ID。 

如果您不指定用户网关的实例ID，则系统默认查询当前地域下所有用户网关的信息
parameters.name: customer_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en:
The tag key. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
标签键。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

一次最多支持输入20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and can be an empty string. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time
fields.help_zh:
标签值。

标签值最多支持128个字符，可以为空字符串，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

一个标签键对应一个标签值。一次最多支持输入20个标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_zh: 用户网关绑定的标签列表

parameters.help_en:

CustomerGateway.description_en: The list of customer gateway information

items.description_en: The information about the customer gateway

Asn.description_en: The autonomous system number of the gateway device in the on-premises data center
Asn.description_zh: 本地数据中心网关设备的自治系统号

AuthKey.description_en: The authentication key of the BGP routing protocol for the gateway device in the on-premises data center
AuthKey.description_zh: 本地数据中心网关设备BGP路由协议的认证密钥

CreateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the customer gateway was created. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp is in Unix format and represents the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC to when the customer gateway was created
CreateTime.description_zh:
创建用户网关的时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建用户网关时的总时长

CustomerGatewayId.description_en: The instance ID of the customer gateway

Description.description_en: The description of the customer gateway

IpAddress.description_en: The IP address of the gateway device in the on-premises data center
IpAddress.description_zh: 本地数据中心网关设备的IP地址

Name.description_en: The name of the customer gateway

ResourceGroupId.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the customer gateway belongs.

You can call [ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html） to query resource group information
ResourceGroupId.description_zh:
用户网关所属的资源组ID。

您可以调用[ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html）接口查询资源组信息

Tag.description_en: The list of tags bound to the customer gateway
Tag.description_zh: 用户网关绑定的标签列表

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list
